scope: Pre-rollover additive preparation for SEA-DEN after the official game center reported FINAL/OT. The exact final, frozen pre-kickoff rating/H4 snapshot, official inactive inventories, reusable source-bound pregame estimates and literal in-game injury wording are preserved under Week 6 with the actual recording time. The pair remains blocked pending the official final gamebook and complete paired game-day reconciliation. This does not advance the active manifest, publish ratings, write current-week personnel/QB overlays, construct fairs or issue a bet.

sources.finding: The official NFL game center reports Denver 17, Seattle 14, FINAL after overtime.

Seattle's official final list names Jalen Milroe (emergency third quarterback), Avery Smith, Drake Thomas, Robert Henry Jr., Chazz Surratt, Montorie Foster Jr. and Brandon Pili inactive. It names Tyrice Knight as the expected starter for Thomas, confirms Jaxon Smith-Njigba active, and also reproduces Denver's final inactive list while confirming Riley Moss active.

Denver's official final list names Pat Surtain II, Sam Ehlinger (emergency third quarterback), Talanoa Hufanga, Kage Casey, Dallen Bentley, Jordan Jackson and Tyler Onyedim inactive. Riley Moss, Taylor Rapp and Sean Fresch Jr. are explicitly active.
Seattle's official in-game update says tight end Elijah Arroyo suffered a shoulder injury in the second quarter and was doubtful to return. This wording does not establish a return.

NFL support says final gamebook PDFs are exposed from game centers. At recording time, the SEA-DEN game center did not expose an accessible Download Game Book PDF, so complete final participation, printed injury/return sequences and exact overtime duration could not yet be source-bound.
